eng50_online_stacker_week8_dry_replay.description: Online ridge-logistic stacker (played-card logit offset plus lead99, mod24, mod25_combined deltas), fit on Week 7 only, predicts Week 8 (14 games); paired log loss vs the played card
eng50_online_stacker_week8_dry_replay.plain_summary: Fitting on one prior week of 14 games, the stacker matched the played card on the next week's log loss (probability positive 0.48) and won fewer decisive games, 2 of 5 against 3; far below power.
